mode: built-in image_gen, one new image per changed category
basePrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE minimalist pixel-art category banner for Minecraft Create. It must be MUCH SIMPLER than a detailed illustration. Only 1 to 3 very large flat shapes suggesting the category; at most 8 colors total, hard square pixels, no gradients, no antialiasing, no fine details, no noise. Style: the very simple cropped brass gears of a Simulated inventory banner, NOT a miniature world scene. LEFT 60 percent of the banner must be an almost solid VERY DARK blue-charcoal #11181e background for readable runtime text; NO objects or bright details there. Only the RIGHT 40 percent contains the category shapes, oversized and cropped by the banner's top and bottom edges. No text. No icon badge. No workshop, no buildings in the distance, no sky, no landscape, no lamps, no decoration, no tiny pipes or bolts, no texture noise, no realistic rendering. GEOMETRY: logical canvas 162x54 pixels, with a single 162x18 banner only in the MIDDLE 18 rows (y18..35); top and bottom 18 rows are pure black letterbox padding. Visible banner has exactly 9:1 width:height. No frame around the outer canvas. Within the strip a simple 1px dark border is okay. Category shapes:

subjects.radiation: one large simple brass meter dial and one yellow radiation trefoil, no numbers
subjects.construction: two broad overlapping gray steel plates and a few large copper corner blocks
subjects.pipes: one wide copper elbow crossing a dark iron pipe, with a single red valve wheel silhouette
subjects.controls: two oversized cream gauge semicircles and three simple red and green square lights
subjects.tanks: two simple broad silver storage tank silhouettes with copper bands
subjects.kinetics: two oversized overlapping brass gear silhouettes, cropped teeth, like a simple Create gear banner
subjects.thermal: one chunky orange zigzag heater shape next to three broad ice-blue cooling fins
subjects.chemistry: two simple copper tower silhouettes joined by a single thick pipe
subjects.reprocessing: a few upright silver rods above one flat cyan pool and one yellow barrier stripe
subjects.logistics: one broad yellow gantry beam with a simple dark hanging hook
subjects.containers: two oversized empty silver bucket silhouettes with copper rims
subjects.liquids: three broad overlapping wavy turquoise and amber liquid bands
subjects.gases: two plain dark gas cylinder silhouettes with one broad lavender vapor curl
subjects.ores: three large angular rust-orange, olive-green and charcoal ore patches in dark gray rock
subjects.minerals: two big angular orange and pale pink mineral crystal shapes
subjects.powders: two broad cream and ochre powder mound silhouettes on a single dark tray
subjects.metals: two oversized stacks of silver and copper ingot shapes
subjects.polymers: one broad curled black rubber strip and one cream plastic slab
subjects.catalysts: one large simple mesh basket silhouette containing a few broad purple pellets
subjects.components: one large brass bearing ring and a simple silver toothed part
subjects.fuel: three broad parallel silver nuclear fuel bars with olive caps
subjects.protection: one oversized dark respirator silhouette with two round cream filters
subjects.other: a large copper wrench silhouette crossing a dark gray toolbox shape

normalization: Trim black padding and nearest-neighbor resize to 162x18, quantize without dithering to at most 8 colors
